messages.content: Back to a disaster recovery setup.
Back on a disaster recovery setup now.
We can stop worrying about IAM roles scoped per service now.
Nothing is blocking us right now. terraform/iam.tf ended up with most of the changes. Having compared the options, Checkov for policy scanning is the best fit.
What about a disaster recovery setup?
OIDC for CI authentication into AWS is what we'll ship with. We can stop worrying about encrypted EBS volumes across all instances now. Rewrote parts of modules/service/main.tf as well.
AWS as the single cloud provider sounds like the better deal to me.
Good news: the VPC with public and private subnets across three zones made it in before the freeze. Agreed.
Separate accounts for production and staging sounds like the better deal to me.
Good news: security groups restricted to named ports made it in before the freeze. Here is the updated plan. Agreed.
What about a disaster recovery setup?
A module for the standard service deployment went smoothly in the end. The error messages are now clearer. Good news: VPC flow logs shipped to the log bucket made it in before the freeze.
Terraform over CloudFormation is what we'll ship with. If this fails again we will revisit the design.
Terragrunt for the DRY module wiring sounds like the better deal to me.
A drift detection job on a daily schedule is the obvious next step. Agreed. Failed jobs are retried twice.
